plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: your finished house at dusk, the emergency line at the top of every page, your services as the chart inside a fuse board's door, your registers linked to the public register, rooms you've lit, and the fault guide that says what to tell you (never how to fix it). Plus a Plan your visit page.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: why each light is there, numbered on your photograph; your projects by kind of work; the EV charger page with the suitability check at your prices; the room designer with a quote from your prices; the dimmer over your own photographs; how a project runs and Before you call.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: the scene keypad that changes the house's light; the house in 3D, room by room, with a quote from your prices; the charger on a driveway in 3D; the whole-house estimate; and your clients' certificates by code with a reminder for the next inspection.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds up to four more pages, like this one: projects, EV charging, lighting and your project.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: the scene keypad, the house in 3D, the driveway in 3D, the estimate and certificates by code.
